item: windows-curses as a Windows-only dependency, so the terminal panel opens on Windows (R602)
summary: Windows installs now include windows-curses, which gives Python the curses module the launcher's terminal panel needs, so the panel opens there without a manual pip install. The marker leaves out Windows on ARM and Pythons after 3.14, which have no wheel (the package publishes no sdist, and a missing wheel would fail the whole install); there the app starts without the panel as before. Linux and macOS never install it, and the Linux-generated lock does not pin it: the lock-vs-manifest test now reads a requirement whose marker excludes the lock's platform as one it need not pin. Not yet run on Windows.
